en: Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's just a monitor. Even if I investigate,
I don't think I'll find anything suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe there's a camera in here,
watching us... Maybe not.

<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is deep, but it isn't filled
up all the way. Still, plenty of water to swim in.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a storage room.
There's a bunch of pool equipment inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>This building is the gym.
That's the same window I saw in there.
<CLT=cltMIND>This building...is the school building.

<CLT=cltMIND>Most of the windows are blocked off,
but one looks like it's usable.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a large diving board.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is also something you would
find at a resort...

<CLT=cltMIND>Some pool rules are posted here.
There's one that I find peculiar...

Swimming is prohibited during nighttime.
Well, I don't really want to swim anyway.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are also some specifications
written here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is 82 feet in length
and is 39 feet wide...

<CLT=cltMIND>The poolside is 13 feet on each end,
and the left and right sides are 8 feet each...

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh. Guess that's just
useless information...

<CLT=cltMIND>What's this...?
There's something at the pool...

A beach chair and a table?
Were these in the warehouse?

With a parasol, this would definitely
look like a celebrity's private pool...

<CLT=cltMIND>But who prepared all this?
Did Tenko do it herself...?
You are late, Shuichi.
Kirumi?
Did you bring the parasol?

Ah, I did, but...
Wait, how do you know about that, Kirumi?

Tenko informed me of her desire to feel
like a celebrity at the pool.
So I made some preparations.
Ah, I see...

I have placed tropical beverages and fruits
in the refrigerator.

If you start to feel cold, I have prepared warm
meals which I can reheat over the stove.
On the poolside, I have prepared oil massages.

In the changing room, I have prepared a variety
of swimsuits to choose from...

Once the parasol is set, everything will be
complete. Whenever you are ready.
Ah, th-thanks...

<CLT=cltMIND>She did all that work...?
I feel kinda bad...

<CLT=cltMIND>I did as Kirumi asked and set up the
parasol, and people started to arrive at the pool.

Kirumi! Thank you so much for preparing
everything!
Nyeeeh, thanks for doing everything.
Thank you, Kirumi.
I am grateful for your care, Kirumi.
This is more people than I had been told.

I'm sorry... I just wanted Himiko to feel like
a celebrity, too!

Can I join? Atua says He wants to feel like
a celebrity too!

If Atua wants to be a celebrity, 
then we might as well invite him too.
S-Sure... If that's what you want, Himiko.

Grrrgghhh...I just wanted to vacation like a
celebrity with Himiko!

<CLT=cltMIND>...Would a god want to be
a celebrity?

Then I shall begin preparing for everyone
else. Will that include you, as well?
Huh? Me too?

Oh, Shuichi can't join. As a degenerate male,
his only job was to help set this up.
...What about Keebo?

Keebo's a robot, so he's neither male nor
female! He barely passes!

...I cannot tell if that remark is robophobic
or not.

Well at the very least, you're better
off than I am...
By the way, Keebo...
Yes?

In your case, would you prefer oil over
tropical juice?

...That won't be necessary. The offer alone
is more than enough.

Keebo, Tenko requested I help her feel like
a celebrity.

And she has included you as one of
her guests...

I will do my utmost to fulfill her request, for
that is how a maid must conduct herself.

So please tell me what food or beverages I
can prepare so you feel like a celebrity.

<CLT=cltMIND>Such pride and dedication...
Kirumi's prowess as a maid is showing!

Um...I do not require food. And I would not
be able to taste it in the first place...

Let's go change into our swimsuits. Shuichi,
you know what'll happen if you peep, right?

Y-You don't have to tell me!
I'm not gonna peep...

Oh, but you're welcome to peep! I'd love an
excuse to exterminate a degenerate!
Miss Tenko, how is the oil massage?

Aaahhhh... My whole body feels like it's
melting away...
Kirumi! More tropical punch please!
Understood. I will also provide a fruit platter.

Aaahhh, I'm so happy, Kirumi! You're making
me feel like a pampered celebrity!

My life-long dream has finally come true!
Thank you so much!

There is no need to thank me.
Your happiness is the reason I serve.
*sigh*... What a pain...

<CLT=cltMIND>You're relaxing right now,
what exactly is a pain?

Out of curiosity, do you really need that
parasol even though we're indoors?

Of course! If you wanna feel like a celebrity,
you absolutely need a parasol!

A robot like you wouldn't understand what it
means to feel like a celebrity, huh Keebo?

Ghhhh...
Th-This is a difficult feeling to understand!

<CLT=cltMIND>After attending to the "celebrities,"
I returned to my room.
